body.title: Fix vibe's read-only tool allowlist and add verifyRuntime's required-tool check

acceptanceChecks: READ_ONLY_SESSION_VIBE_TOOL_NAMES is the single source of truth read by all three call sites
verifyRuntime throws when an unexpected tool is reported (existing behavior, unchanged)

tests.name: verifyRuntime throws when an unexpected tool is reported (existing behavior, unchanged)
